mentions.name: faitps
mentions.description: This project explores triply periodic non-minimal surfaces, providing a demo surface builder with two levels of control. Unlike the commonly studied minimal surfaces used in thermal management, acoustics, and medical applications, these non-minimal surfaces are more governable, are conjugatable (including conjugations with different periods of self), generalize to non-periodic or partially periodic surfaces, and work in other space configurations such as bi-periodic curves covering 2D space with self-replicating hexagons. If the current 2D experiments extend to 3D, the work aims to open a new direction in implicit modeling.
mentions.problem: Triply periodic minimal surfaces are the standard in thermal management, acoustics, and medical applications, but minimality itself contributes little to practicality; they are used mainly because they are better studied than non-minimal surfaces.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm exploring triply periodic but non-minimal surfaces. https://codeberg.org/okaleniuk/faitps

Triply periodic minimal surfaces are the golden standard in thermal management, acoustics, and even medical applications. But minimality itself doesn't contribute much to practicality. We use them because they are simply studied better than the non-minimal surfaces.

So I'm studying the non-minimals. They are much more governable, what I link to is a demo of a surface builder with two levels of control.
